transform.name: fixed-cohort-stored-status-v1
transform.method: Join the retained historical 2143 ids to preparation.perId by id, verify its atEvent fields exactly match the historical row, and count identical literal status values under the shared count-evidence contract.

metric.definition: Number of distinct retained fixed-cohort ids with the exact recorded lifecycle status

population.definition: Exact ids of the retained source cohort; includes subsequent terminal dispositions

status.definition: Exact literal status recorded on each retained work-item row; no inference about execution or bug resolution

contract.zeroMeaning: No id in this exact retained cohort has the stated literal status in this snapshot
contract.comparisonRule: compare only identical metric, population, cutoff, status semantics, writer, unit, exactness, zero meaning, and scope; otherwise materialize a named reconciliation transform under one new common contract

claimabilityComparison.reason: The historical operational category counts and the current three-way burn_down counts use different producers and category precedence. This explicit transform compares stored lifecycle status only. P010 claimable counts and claim rates still require one stated fleet spec and comparable stated windows after P009 adoption.

limitations: Recorded lifecycle status does not certify recent item work, reproduction acceptance, successful bug fixes, terminal authority or owner permission.
Historical measuredAt is the retained snapshot measurement; fixedAt identifies cohort selection and is not asserted as a transaction-consistent as-of timestamp for later enrichment.
This is analysis of saved snapshots, not a fresh live or final deployed census.
Terminal rows remain explicit status observations; no extra P010 outcome bucket or acceptance-contract amendment is inferred.
